title: Withdrawing the Paloma Business Balance to the Business Bank Account
content:
When the owner withdraws the whole withdrawable amount of the Paloma Business balance, the withdrawal goes to the business's verified US bank account and is booked as one withdrawal for the current billing period, numbered after the period's earlier withdrawals.

### When the withdrawable amount is worked out

The withdrawable amount is not worked out until the balance carries an extra seat fee for every user added in the past month while more users were active than the plan includes.

The withdrawable amount is worked out only after an upgrade that took effect inside the current billing period carries its proration charge on the balance.

Before the withdrawable amount is worked out, the most recent debit-card deposit must carry its deposit fee on the balance.

### Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Destination | The business's verified US bank account |
| Entry booked | One withdrawal for the current billing period |
| Number in the period | The next number after the period's earlier withdrawals, the first being 1 |
| Balance | Lowered by the amount withdrawn |

### Tool: `withdraw_business_balance_ad66ed9d`

**Capability.** The business owner withdraws money from their own Paloma Business balance to the business's verified US bank account. One call books one withdrawal for the account's current billing period with the amount and in-period sequence number given and takes that amount off the business balance. Afterwards the owner sees the withdrawal on the balance history and a balance lowered by it; the money is on its way to the business's verified US bank account.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `business_account_id` | The Paloma Business account reference number of the owner's account, as returned by the Paloma Business account lookup | Identifier |
| `seq_in_period` | The sequence number of this withdrawal within the current billing period | Integer count starting at 1 |
| `amount_usd` | The amount withdrawn | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the withdrawal entry booked), `business_account_id` (the account), `billing_period_start` (YYYY-MM-DD start of the period), `seq_in_period` (integer sequence in the period), `amount_usd` (USD withdrawn, 2 decimals) and `balance_usd` (resulting USD balance, 2 decimals). The presence of `ledger_entry_id` indicates the withdrawal is booked.
